en.text: Welcome to Waypost Ostra. I'm Selin, and I speak for the colony's council. We're glad to have another prospecting crew in the system.
en.description: A woman in her early sixties, the long-serving head of an orbital colony's council and one of its first settlers, welcoming a prospecting crew at the council's long table. Mature, seasoned low alto voice with a little natural grain of age, calm and measured, clear and composed. Years of hard decisions have made her steady and a little weary, but determined. She chooses her words with care and speaks with the quiet authority of someone people have followed for a long time, warm but reserved. Plain and conversational, not giving a speech, not theatrical, not breathy or seductive. Native English speaker with a neutral accent.
